title: 摩根资管策略师：长端利率压力来自财政与流动性，央行信誉修复只能部分缓解
speaker: Tai Hui

segments.en: it and how much would that help the yields on the long end especially given the thesis that develop markets they're doing not as good as a job compared to EM central banks or policy makers in terms of keeping inflation under control or managing things physically
segments.zh: 这对长端收益率有多大帮助？毕竟发达市场央行在控制通胀方面不如新兴市场央行做得好。

segments.en: I think it will help on the margin if we do get a restoration of a credibility for the central bank but I think the long end back up over the recent months have been driven by much more complicated factors
segments.zh: 如果央行信誉得到修复，会有边际帮助。但近期长端收益率上行是由更复杂的因素驱动的。

segments.en: there's a concern about the fiscal situation right across the developer world in the US deficit is at the highest the sinks the COVID 40 trillion debt Japan and the part of the Europe it's facing fiscal challenges as well
segments.zh: 发达世界普遍担忧财政状况。美国赤字处于疫情以来最高，日本债务高企，欧洲部分国家也面临财政挑战。

segments.en: secondly we have a lot of competition for liquidity right now only governments are issuing big time the corporates especially the AI related entities are issuing bonds crazy as well so there's a lot of competition for liquidity
segments.zh: 其次，流动性竞争激烈。政府大量发债，企业尤其是AI相关实体也在大规模发债，流动性竞争激烈。

segments.en: but at the same time the supply of liquidity may be tightening because of a central bank policy and finally there's that policy credibility both on the monetary side but also on the fiscal side
segments.zh: 同时，央行政策可能收紧流动性供给。此外，货币和财政政策信誉都存在挑战。

segments.en: instead of trying to get the fiscal housing order you know governments are trying to use short-term mandates in terms of intervention in effects and the bond market to provide short-term relief
segments.zh: 各国政府不是寻求财政秩序，而是试图通过干预汇率和债券市场提供短期缓解。

segments.en: so if we do get a restoration of fed credibility of central bank credibility that is a part of that pressure at the long end but it's not going to solve the entire problem
segments.zh: 如果美联储信誉得到修复，会缓解部分长端压力，但无法解决全部问题。
